regression_note: The \b before 0 in the thc_free regex is what this fixture locks: without it, the '50% THC' substring's trailing digit pattern falsely matched a thc-free marker and zeroed THC on this and similar 1:1 products across the catalogue. Also exercises: raw-herb weight (10000mg Vijaya Extract) correctly ignored in favour of the name-first + chemical-full-name (Cannabidiol/Tetrahydrocannabinol -> CBD/THC) totals.
